description: Find flights between two cities or airports for given dates. Returns airport codes, booking links to compare live fares (Aviasales, Kiwi.com, Skyscanner, Google Flights) and, when available, recently seen cheapest fares. Flexible: without a date it returns the cheapest recently seen dates; without a destination it returns the cheapest destinations from the origin. Prices change constantly; the live price is on the booking site.

currency.description: 3-letter currency for fares, e.g. EUR, USD.

depart_date.description: Departure date, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for flexible dates: returns the cheapest recently seen dates.

destination.description: Arrival city or airport (name or IATA code), e.g. 'Lisbon'. Omit for 'anywhere': returns the cheapest destinations.

month.description: Flexible dates within this month, YYYY-MM (used when depart_date is omitted).

origin.description: Departure city or airport (name or IATA code), e.g. 'Madrid' or 'MAD'.

return_date.description: Return date, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for one-way.

name: search_flights
title: Search flights
